content.text:
**Finding submitted — deviation (high severity).**

- **Responsive clause:** duplicate-numbered § 12.4 (p0046) — term-plus-24-month, any-territory, undefined-scope non-compete binding Customer. This is walk-away territory and fails every fallback element (not a named product, post-term > 12 months, no internal-development or acquisition carve-out). It also contradicts § 12.3 (p0044), where Vendor acknowledges Customer has given no non-compete commitment.
- **Other locations checked:** § 12 generally, § 12.3, the other § 12.4 no-hire covenant (p0045 — left for the non-solicitation rule), § 13 licence grant, and a document-wide search for compete/field-of-use/territory restrictions. No other Customer-side non-compete exists.
- **Proposal (preferred level, validated ok:true):** one surgical replace turning the prohibition into an express permission — "Customer may develop, market, sell, or acquire any product or service that competes with Vendor in any territory." — preserving the numbering and the untouched tail, with the narrowed fallback offered in the comment.
